summary: Coos Co., NH tower listed standing; Forest Lookouts describes a 60-ft Aermotor tower in Feb 2020 imagery; no build date, owner or access rules found.

facts.design: Aermotor tower, about 60 feet tall, per Forest Lookouts (Feb 2020 Google Earth imagery)

events.note: Standing in February 2020 Google Earth imagery, per Forest Lookouts

evidence.supports: listed as a standing tower on Whitcomb Mountain in Coos County
60-foot Aermotor tower, standing, in Feb 2020 Google Earth imagery

evidence.quote: Coos County Private February 2020: 60-foot Aermotor tower, standing. (Google Earth)

corrections.proposed: Remove agency; record ownership as private
corrections.why: Forest Lookouts uses Private as a one-word label in its header block. It names no agency, so agency: Private misstates the field.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two short sources. The Aermotor design and about 60-ft height rest only on the Forest Lookouts entry, which cites Google Earth imagery from February 2020; the entry is not dated otherwise. Private is read as ownership, but the page does not expand it. Two web searches returned map and listing pages (a mytopo ridge page and FFLA list pages) that were not read. No build date, builder, owner or access rules found. Editor may want a reference check (Baird and Haartz field guide, Coos County registry) before publishing.
